description: Repoint DNS for the apex and www onto the Cloudflare Pages project. The zone currently holds four GitHub Pages A records plus a www CNAME to the old GitHub Pages hostname. Replace with CNAME records to pol2000.pages.dev. Verify TLS before announcing.
notes:
Pages project 'pol2000' lives in the capp Cloudflare account, git-connected to pol2k/pol2000, branch main, empty build command. First production build SUCCEEDED at pol2000.pages.dev. Custom domains pol2000.com and www.pol2000.com are attached and awaiting HTTP validation. Cross-account is accepted: the pol2000.com zone sits in the other (personal) Cloudflare account, so Pages validates over HTTP rather than auto-creating DNS. REMAINING - repoint DNS in the zone: delete the four GitHub Pages A records (185.199.108-111.153), add CNAME pol2000.com -> pol2000.pages.dev, and change CNAME www.pol2000.com from pol2k.github.io -> pol2000.pages.dev. Recommend DNS-only (grey cloud) so traffic reaches the Pages edge directly and orange-to-orange routing is avoided. BLOCKED: no available credential can write DNS in that zone - the local token file is scoped to the other account, the MCP token lacks the permission, and wrangler OAuth has zone read only. Account and zone identifiers deliberately omitted here because this file is published at pol2000.com/.beads/issues.jsonl.
DONE. Apex and www CNAME to pol2000.pages.dev (DNS-only). Both custom domains reached status=active with valid certificates (ssl_verify_result 0). Verified 9 of 10 linked decks serve real reveal.js content through the Cloudflare edge; the tenth is the deleted web scraping deck, tracked separately.

title: Add a 404.html so missing paths do not silently serve the homepage
description: Verified on the live Cloudflare deployment: requesting any non-existent path (e.g. /this-does-not-exist-xyz) returns HTTP 200 with the full homepage rather than a 404. Cloudflare Pages falls back to index.html when the project has no 404.html at the root. Consequence: every broken link on the site looks fine to a browser and to link checkers, and students land on the homepage with no explanation. Fix: add a French 404.html at the repo root.
